description: pkix-lint/src/report.rs:38 — A private de_cow_static function is defined in report.rs that is byte-for-byte identical to the crate-level de_cow_static in lib.rs (lib.rs:141). The report.rs copy shadows the crate-level one because it is in a sibling module. If the two implementations ever diverge, serde round-trips for EvaluationReport fields will silently use different deserialization logic than Finding fields. Fix: remove the duplicate in report.rs and use crate::de_cow_static (or pub(crate) it from lib.rs).
title: de_cow_static duplicated in report.rs vs lib.rs
